_doc: Reusable LTX-2.5 prompt fragments for anime I2V. A shot prompt = style + subject/scene (from the keyframe) + motion + camera + audio. Status per fragment: 'untested' | 'works' | 'weak' | 'fails' (updated from Phase 1 tests in docs/phase1.md). Tested 2026-11-07 at 960x544, 8 s, distilled, I2V from qwen21_8s keyframes (renders/exp/library_camera_motion_audio/).

style.default: Anime style, 2D cel animation, hand-drawn Japanese TV anime look, clean line art, flat cel shading.
style.limited_animation: Anime style, 2D cel animation animated on twos, limited animation with held poses, clean line art, flat cel shading.

static.tested: still drifts forward; LTX defaults to a slow push

push_in.text: Slow push-in camera toward the subject.

pull_out.text: Slow pull-out camera revealing more of the scene.

pan_left.text: Slow pan left across the scene.

pan_right.text: Slow pan right across the scene.

tilt_up.text: Slow tilt up from the ground to the sky.

tracking_side.text: Camera tracks sideways alongside the subject at the same speed.
tracking_side.tested: needs a moving subject; little camera motion on a static scene

orbit.text: Camera slowly orbits around the subject.

idle.text: The character breathes gently and blinks, small natural idle movement.

wind_hair_cloth.text: Wind blows the character's hair and clothes.

head_turn.text: The character slowly turns their head toward the camera.

walk.text: The character walks forward at a calm pace.
walk.tested: from an upper-body keyframe the face disintegrates; use a wider (full-body) keyframe

run_speedlines.text: The character sprints, anime speed lines streak across the background.

ambient_env.text: Clouds drift slowly, leaves sway, light flickers gently; no people.

ambient_city.text: Sound of distant city traffic and wind.

ambient_nature.text: Sound of gentle waves, cicadas and birds.

rain.text: Sound of heavy rain and splashing water.

dialogue.note: Keep lines short (< ~8 words per 8 s clip). Put the spoken words in double quotes.
dialogue.tested: loud (-27.5 dB) but intelligibility/lip-sync not yet verified (needs ASR or listening)

sfx_door.text: A door slams shut with a loud bang.
sfx_door.tested: -29 dB; content not verified by ear

negative.default: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, live action, blurry, low quality, distorted face, deformed hands, extra limbs, flickering, jitter, watermark, text, subtitles

rules_of_thumb: Use I2V from a keyframe; T2V drifts off-style.
Give big motions room: 8 s for push-in + head turn; 5 s only for low-motion shots.
Prefer 1280x720 for faces; 960x544 is fine for environments and drafts.
One camera move per shot; one main action per character.
LTX drifts forward by default; for a truly static shot, freeze/trim in edit or accept a slow push.
Walking/large body motion needs a wide keyframe; never animate a walk from an upper-body framing.
